content: The recommended daily amount of soluble fiber as a supplement is 4 grams (equivalent to 2 teaspoons) taken orally three times a day (TID). This should be mixed with 4 to 8 ounces of liquid or soft food. For individuals aged 12 years and older, the dosage remains 4 grams (2 teaspoons) orally three times daily. For children aged 6 to 11 years, the recommended dose is 2 grams (1 teaspoon) orally three times daily. The soluble fiber powder should always be added to 4 to 8 ounces of liquid or soft food before consumption. Refer to the adult dosing guidelines for further details. Gastrointestinal side effects may include bloating, flatulence, and general gastrointestinal distress. Hypersensitivity reactions to the product or its excipients may occur. Some formulations of this product may contain phenylalanine, potassium, or sodium, so caution is advised in patients with specific dietary restrictions or sensitivities. Use this supplement cautiously in patients with esophageal strictures, ulcers, stenosis, intestinal adhesions, gastrointestinal obstruction, fecal impaction, or difficulty swallowing. Insufficient fluid intake while using this product may increase the risk of fecal impaction or bowel obstruction. Patients should consult a healthcare professional before using this product. In pregnancy, this supplement is generally considered safe. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
